user.title: Person Tracker
user.description: Add the people you want to track.

camera_first.title: Person Tracker
camera_first.description: Add the cameras to watch. A camera must be assigned to an HA area and needs at least one trigger binary sensor.

ai_task.title: Person Tracker
ai_task.description: Optionally select the AI task entity used for identification. By default the HA default AI task entity is used.

error.invalid_camera: The camera must be an existing camera entity.
error.duplicate_camera: This camera is already in the map.
error.camera_without_area: This camera is not assigned to an HA area. Assign an area (Settings → Areas) first.
error.no_triggers: This camera needs at least one trigger binary sensor.
error.invalid_trigger: One or more triggers are not binary_sensor entities.
error.invalid_ai_task_entity: The AI task entity must be an existing AI task entity.
error.no_ai_task_entity: No AI task entity is available. Configure an AI provider and set a default AI task entity, or select one here.
